fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-04-12 (evening, 18:50): Rs. 75,000 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved. The online submission was made by Deviga Murugan (9000000058). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Karthik Shankar, using the number 9000000306. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100037. A further person, Harish Murugan, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000180, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, apartment complex, mobile number, suspect, call detail, evening, receiving account
